user_name.title: User Name
user_name.description: Display name of the user. Required (non-blank).

email_address.title: Email Address
email_address.description: Email address of the user. Required (non-blank).

password.title: Password
password.description: New plaintext password; if omitted, the existing password is left unchanged.

current_password.title: Current Password
current_password.description: The caller's current password. Required when changing your own password; ignored when an administrator sets someone else's.

ssh_private_key.title: Ssh Private Key
ssh_private_key.description: SSH private key associated with the user.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Names of the roles assigned to this user.

status.title: Status
status.description: Account status: `active` or `disabled`. Omitted leaves it unchanged. Requires the Manage users permission.
